summary: Recursively frees a node in a linked tree/list. First recurses into the child pointer at byte offset 0x44 when non-null, then recurses into the pointer at byte offset 0x4C when both the guard field at offset 0x40 and that pointer are non-null. Calls SceneGraph as a shutdown/validation check and returns -1 immediately if it reports failure; otherwise runs the TwoFunctionCallChain teardown, frees the node via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and returns 0.

local_names.guardField: guard field at byte offset 0x40 (a1[16]); both it and the second child must be non-null

operations.description: If the pointer at byte offset 0x44 (a1[17]) is non-null, recurses into that child first.
Recursively calls sub_549110 on the child pointer at byte offset 0x44 to free the child subtree.
If the guard field at byte offset 0x40 (a1[16]) is non-null AND the pointer at byte offset 0x4C (a1[19]) is non-null, recurses into the second child.
Recursively calls sub_549110 on the pointer at byte offset 0x4C to free the second child subtree.
Calls SceneGraph(a1) as a shutdown/validation check; a non-zero return aborts the free.
When SceneGraph returns non-zero, returns -1 immediately without running teardown or freeing the node.
Runs TwoFunctionCallChain(a1), the cleanup/teardown sequence, before the node is freed.
Frees the current node via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Returns 0 on the successful free path.
